checkpoint.purpose: v2c: v2 logic plus unquoted-requirement guard and label-free invariant checker, frozen at git HEAD 9688906. inputs/products.jsonl, inputs/cases.jsonl and all 16 predictions/*.jsonl are byte-identical to the v2 files in 20261010-sku-gate-tasks.zip (SHA-256 listed in each predictions/manifest.json); copy them from there to rebuild the full run directory. v2b (git HEAD 74901a6) is a superseded run whose first invariant checker keyed sibling-swap twins without the fixed pair; its predictions are also byte-identical to v2 and it was never label-evaluated.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: v2c evaluation/summary.json holds aggregate metrics and per-row gold decisions with Luna rationales for the 37 gold-review rows; evaluation/disagreements.jsonl holds gold decision, gold rows and rationale for rows where A/B disagree with gold. invariants/* and v2b files contain no label content. Raw labels.jsonl is not included.
